methodological_note: Largest mitigation potential of any single option per IPCC AR6 SYR Fig 4.4. Median impact of 5 GtCO2/yr at full effect calibrated against IPCC WGIII pathway analysis for tripling renewables by 2030. Energy mix deltas include coal (-15.5 pp), oil (-7.5 pp), gas (-5.5 pp) offset by solar (+15.5 pp) and wind (+13 pp) at 2074. Projection baseline: SSP2-4.5. Resources include increased minerals demand (+6.5 Gt/yr) and reduced fossil fuels (-6.0 Gt/yr) at 2074.
